code:
apiVersion: scaffolder.backstage.io/v1beta3
kind: Template
metadata:
  name: nodejs-service
spec:
  parameters:
    - title: Service details
      required: [name, owner]
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        owner:
          type: string
caption: Two required fields -- fewer things a developer can type wrong.

code:
# .ci/pipeline.yaml
extends: templates/reusable-nodejs-pipeline@v3
stages: [build, test, scan, deploy]

# catalog-info.yaml
kind: Component
metadata:
  name: ${{ values.name }}
spec:
  owner: ${{ values.owner }}
caption: CI/CD extends Chapter 6's shared template; the catalog entry is pre-filled, not added later.

steps.label: 1. fetch:template
steps.sub: Fills the skeleton's placeholders with the form's values

steps.label: 2. publish:github
steps.sub: Pushes the filled-in skeleton as a real repository

steps.label: 3. catalog:register
steps.sub: Adds the new service to the catalog automatically

steps.label: 4. fs:rename
steps.sub: Seeds empty dev/staging/prod overlays in the GitOps config repo
